title: Castle with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#6a8fe0"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#4a6fd0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="wall" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f0d890"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#d4b860"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="tower" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f5e0a0"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#dcc070"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Main castle body -->
  <rect x="20" y="45" width="60" height="45" rx="2" fill="url(#wall)"/>
  <rect x="20" y="45" width="60" height="6" fill="#c8a850"/>

  <!-- Left tower -->
  <rect x="8" y="30" width="20" height="60" rx="2" fill="url(#tower)"/>
  <rect x="8" y="30" width="20" height="5" fill="#d4b860"/>
  <!-- Left tower battlements -->
  <rect x="8" y="24" width="6" height="8" fill="#e8d090"/>
  <rect x="17" y="24" width="6" height="8" fill="#e8d090"/>

  <!-- Right tower -->
  <rect x="72" y="30" width="20" height="60" rx="2" fill="url(#tower)"/>
  <rect x="72" y="30" width="20" height="5" fill="#d4b860"/>
  <!-- Right tower battlements -->
  <rect x="72" y="24" width="6" height="8" fill="#e8d090"/>
  <rect x="81" y="24" width="6" height="8" fill="#e8d090"/>

  <!-- Middle tower top -->
  <rect x="34" y="22" width="32" height="25" rx="2" fill="#f8ecd0"/>
  <rect x="34" y="22" width="32" height="4" fill="#d4b860"/>
  <!-- Battlements -->
  <rect x="34" y="16" width="7" height="8" fill="#f0e0b0"/>
  <rect x="46" y="16" width="7" height="8" fill="#f0e0b0"/>
  <rect x="58" y="16" width="7" height="8" fill="#f0e0b0"/>

  <!-- Flags -->
  <line x1="37" y1="16" x2="37" y2="6" stroke="#e06060" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polygon points="37,6 48,9 37,12" fill="#ff7060"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="16" x2="50" y2="4" stroke="#e06060" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polygon points="50,4 61,7 50,10" fill="#ff7060"/>
  <line x1="62" y1="16" x2="62" y2="8" stroke="#e06060" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polygon points="62,8 70,10 62,12" fill="#ff7060"/>

  <!-- Gate -->
  <path d="M40 90 L40 72 Q50 62 60 72 L60 90 Z" fill="#a07030"/>
  <path d="M40 90 L40 72 Q50 62 60 72 L60 90 Z" fill="none" stroke="#c89040" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Windows on left tower -->
  <rect x="14" y="44" width="8" height="10" rx="4" fill="#7ec8e0"/>
  <rect x="14" y="62" width="8" height="10" rx="4" fill="#7ec8e0"/>

  <!-- Windows on right tower -->
  <rect x="78" y="44" width="8" height="10" rx="4" fill="#7ec8e0"/>
  <rect x="78" y="62" width="8" height="10" rx="4" fill="#7ec8e0"/>

  <!-- Smiling face on main wall -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="56" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#3a3a3a"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="56" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#3a3a3a"/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx="39.5" cy="54" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="63.5" cy="54" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="31" cy="63" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#ff9080" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="69" cy="63" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#ff9080" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M36 66 Q50 78 64 66" fill="none" stroke="#3a3a3a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Nose / door knob -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="60" r="2.5" fill="#c89040"/>

  <!-- Ground / grass -->
  <rect x="0" y="90" width="100" height="10" fill="#70c070"/>
  <ellipse cx="15" cy="92" rx="12" ry="4" fill="#60b060"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="94" rx="15" ry="4" fill="#60b060"/>
  <ellipse cx="85" cy="92" rx="12" ry="4" fill="#60b060"/>

  <!-- Little flowers -->
  <circle cx="10" cy="90" r="2" fill="#ffb0d0"/>
  <circle cx="10" cy="90" r="0.8" fill="#ffe060"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="91" r="2" fill="#ffb0d0"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="91" r="0.8" fill="#ffe060"/>
</svg>
